summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity to represent documents attached to a site within the system. Contains basic identifiers.
purpose: To encapsulate references to documents related to specific sites.

summary: Implements the WelcomeStaffAdmin page for staff administrators. Manages display and filtering of student employment applications by site, discipline, and date range, with error/warning handling and controls for filtering and refreshing data.
purpose: To provide administrators a dashboard to filter, view, and audit student employment applications, with UI components for feedback and error management.

workflows.name: View and Filter Applications
steps: User selects Site and Discipline from respective dropdowns.
User sets Start Date and End Date fields (with date pickers).
User may check or uncheck Show Withdrawn.
Validators ensure valid and complete dates (Start and End required, End >= Start, correct formats).
User clicks Refresh, which triggers data refresh for grid.
User can click name/email links for more details.

business_rules: Date fields must not be empty.
End Date must not be before Start Date.
Date values must match organization-defined formats.
Withdrawn applications are shown/hidden per checkbox.
conditions: If user changes Site or Discipline selection, data should refresh.
If Show Withdrawn is checked, include withdrawn apps.
system_behavior: Maintains error and warning panels for feedback.
Auto-refresh on dropdown or filter change.
JavaScript variables set on page load for client-side scripts.
dependencies: Data source object bound to grid.
Resources for field labels and messages.
exceptions: If UserSession is not present, data selection is cancelled.
Errors in grid/application loading are surfaced via UI panels.

summary: Defines the ServiceCode entity and related retrieval functions for listing, localizing, and filtering codes by course or timetable. Supports bilingual display and categorization of codes.
purpose: To provide access, categorization, and localization for service codes, which may be used across courses and timetables.

workflows.name: Retrieve and Localize Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to get all codes with provided session.
If displaying per course, call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID.
If displaying per timetable, call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
For each record, use alternate language fields if session context requires.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true in session, use NameAlt and NotesAlt for display.
conditions: Use appropriate retrieval method based on context (all, by course, by timetable).
system_behavior: Supports bilingual/alternate language labeling based on session.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.

summary: Implements the SiteProfileHistory entity and workflows for retrieving and displaying the audit history of changes to site profiles. Includes methods to localize fields and format display for UI, with deep ties to user session and audit details.
purpose: To provide a complete change and audit history for site profile edits, including what field was changed, by whom, and when. Used for transparency and historical accountability.

workflows.name: Retrieve and Display Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, AgencyID, session to get list.
For each change, fill all fields (including localized variants).
Display in grid with formatted user, date, and phone details, including tooltips.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true in session, use alternate language fields.
If changed by SysAdmin or Support, special labeling is applied.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted dynamically built from user context.
conditions: Display of name and agency depends on user and sysadmin context.
system_behavior: Audit trails every profile change including user and context.
dependencies: Session context for language and phone formatting.
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, list retrieval is cancelled.
